title: Second-century Latin inscribed on rockets
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Second-century Latin inscribed on rockets, about unspecified at NASA, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then you have Diana Pulka also saying that second century Latin was written inscribed on you know some of these missions like the rockets and stuff.

plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels says that Diana Pasulka, a professor who studies religion and belief in UFOs, has said that second-century Latin was written or inscribed on some NASA missions, such as on the rockets. Why that would be, the telling does not say, but it is offered as a hint of hidden meaning in the space programme.
